summary:
Iteration 12: validated the 'natural email' fix (no container box) and real Plain Text sending. Backend: 10 new pytest cases (unit compose_email_html/wrap_email_html + /api/templates/preview HTML & text-only + campaign start pipeline) all pass; full regression suite 159 passed / 1 skipped (sequential run). Frontend: Templates preview verified via Playwright — HTML template renders as plain natural HTML inside the iframe (no , no background-color, no border-radius, no 600px card), variables substituted, imgs email-safe, Desktop/Mobile toggle works; plain-text-only template renders as simple 
 text. Tracking regression verified (click rewrite + open pixel still injected in the natural HTML). ONE real gap found: 'visually empty' HTML from the rich text editor (e.g. '
', '

', '
 
') is treated as HTML, so a user who clears the editor to send Plain Text still gets an HTML email.

minor.issue:
Emptiness check uses content_html.strip(). The rich text editor leaves markup like '
', '


', '

', '

 

' when the user deletes all content, so the template is still sent/previewed as HTML (with the wrapper + signature) instead of real Plain Text. Repro: 5/5 params fail in /app/backend/tests/test_iter12_edge.py. Suggested fix: strip tags/  (e.g. html_to_text(content_html).strip() and no ) before deciding HTML vs plain text, applied in api.py preview and both worker paths.

For plain-text templates the account signature is NOT appended to content_text, but the UI footnote says the preview includes the default account signature. At send time worker appends html_to_text(signature) to text_body, so preview and real email differ.

issues: The preview iframe uses background '#f4f4f5' (grey) while the email itself has no background; since the goal is 'fundo do cliente', a white iframe background would represent the delivered email more faithfully.
Footnote text 'inclui a assinatura da conta predefinida' is inaccurate for plain-text templates (no signature shown).

critical_code_review_comments:
email_service.wrap_email_html/compose_email_html are correct: only a
with font-family/font-size/line-height/color, signature separated by

, no table/background/border/border-radius/max-width card.

HTML-vs-text branching logic is duplicated in three places (api.py preview, worker._send_job, worker._send_sequence_step). Extract a single helper (e.g. build_email_bodies()) to avoid divergence — this is exactly why the empty-editor case would need three fixes.
rewrite_links uses email.utils.quote for the tracked URL, which does not percent-encode ':' '/' '&' — query params of the original link can break the tracking redirect (pre-existing).

success_rate.backend: 100% (159 passed / 1 skipped) on the main suite; 0% on the 5 new intentional edge-case assertions in test_iter12_edge.py
success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (HTML preview natural, plain-text preview, desktop/mobile toggle)

seed_data_creation: Temporary groups/contacts/templates/campaigns prefixed TEST_iter12_* and qa_iter12_* created by pytest and deleted in teardown. UI templates were only previewed, never saved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stale assertions in test_iter8.py (TestTemplatePreview.test_preview_returns_email_safe_html, test_preview_uses_text_when_no_html, TestSendPipeline.test_compose_email_html_unit) and test_iter9.py (test_content_text_variable_and_plain_text_intact) were updated to the new no-container / empty email_html behaviour. IMPORTANT: run pytest with '-n 0'; the pre-configured xdist loadscope parallelism makes older files (backend_test.py, test_iter4/6) fail with KeyError 'id' because they share class-level state across classes — those are test-harness artifacts, not app bugs. test_iter12_edge.py is an intentionally failing spec for the visually-empty-HTML gap; it should pass after the fix.
rca_of_the_issue:
api.py and worker.py decide plain-text vs HTML with `content_html.strip()`. A contenteditable editor never returns '' after the user deletes the content — it returns '
' or '


'. So the branch takes the HTML path, wraps the (empty) body plus the signature and sends an HTML email, defeating the 'send EFETIVAMENTE as Plain Text' requirement. Fix: compare the text content of the HTML (tags stripped,   removed) and also allow HTML when an is present.
